simple.meaning: חֲלַקָּה (chălaqqâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “flattery.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H2514. chalaqqah [ חֲלַקָּה ] noun feminine smoothness, flattery , only plural absolute: fine promises, בַּחֲלַקּ֑וֺת יַחֲנִיף Dan 11:32 (perhaps directly from חָלָק , exceptional plural, compare קְטַנּוֺת קְטַנִּים, קְטַנָּה, גְּמַלִּים, ).

occurrences.englishText: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong, and take action.
